answer: Make cashing out the checkpoint. Rewards descend a terrace of vesting steps, one per epoch, and a willow audit traces each withdrawal back through its branching sources. If k identities drain into the same sink wallet, every step for all of them lengthens k-fold and that cluster's share of the epoch's reward tide is split k ways. A lone honest agent loses nothing; each added clone delays and shrinks every sibling's income, and fresh sinks restart the climb.
